description: Tropos's single/multi-radio, wireless 802.11 a/b/g/n MetroMesh routers provide a secure, high-performance, easy to deploy, and cost-effective networking solution for outdoor environments. Tropos routers support IEEE 802.1X and 802.11i with AES encryption and secure EAP types while operating in FIPS 140-2 mode.
